title: Too Hard, Too Easy, Just Right: Performance-Driven Challenge Adaptation in Virtual Reality Firefighter Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.38117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective firefighter training requires practice under dynamic and stressful emergency conditions, yet real-world live-fire exercises are costly, risky, and difficult to scale. Virtual Reality (VR) offers a safe and controllable alternative, but many existing VR firefighter training systems rely on fixed scenarios or provide limited difficulty adaptation, making it difficult to maintain an appropriate level of challenge for skill development as trainees' performance changes over time. To address this limitation, we present ProACT, a performance-driven adaptive training system that regulates scenario difficulty through closed-loop interactions between trainee performance and simulated fire dynamics. Specifically, ProACT combines a global module that continuously adjusts scene-level fire spread dynamics in real time based on trainee performance with a local module that periodically updates object-level flammability across the environment.

translated_title: 太难、太易、刚刚好：虚拟现实消防员训练中基于表现的挑战自适应
translated_abstract: 有效的消防员训练需要在动态且充满压力的紧急条件下进行练习，然而现实中的真火演练成本高昂、风险大且难以规模化。虚拟现实（VR）提供了一种安全可控的替代方案，但许多现有的VR消防员训练系统依赖固定场景或仅提供有限的难度自适应，难以随着学员表现的变化维持适合技能发展的挑战水平。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ProACT，一个基于表现驱动的自适应训练系统，通过学员表现与模拟火势动态之间的闭环交互来调节场景难度。具体而言，ProACT结合了一个根据学员表现实时持续调整场景级火势蔓延动态的全局模块，以及一个周期性更新环境中物体级可燃性的局部模块。
tldr: 本文提出ProACT系统，通过学员表现与模拟火势动态之间的闭环反馈，实时调节VR消防员训练场景中的火势蔓延和物体可燃性，使训练难度始终与学员能力水平相匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ProACT, a performance-driven adaptive VR firefighter training system that dynamically adjusts scene-level fire spread and object-level flammability through closed-loop interaction between trainee performance and simulated fire dynamics, maintaining an optimal challenge level as trainee skills evolve.
